en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of an ornate stone staircase and a medieval-style bastion or terrace, viewed through an arched passageway. Several statues of figures in armor line the walls. In the background, there is a distinctive round tower with a pointed roof and arched windows, typical of neo-Romanesque architecture. The scene exudes a historic and somewhat monumental European feel. Printed text is present at the bottom of the postcard.
